_comment: BIOMES BY ALTITUDE (2026-10-31). The biome erosion is vanilla's peaks value (-0.9) above the snow line (terra_continental:alpine/above_snow > 0, blended over 20 blocks) and kept out of the peaks and slopes bands (>= -0.37) below it, so frozen/jagged/howling peaks cover only ground above the line and lower slopes get their ordinary biomes (playtest: peak biomes covered whole ranges from y ~250, their snow a palette). Replaces the giant-only pull to peaks (giant_biome, 2026-10-24): the giant's top is above the line anyway. Biome selection only; terrain reads terra_continental:noise/continent/erosion.
